items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: We all have had experiences with Benny Goodman you know, most of them not greatly pleasurable.

No. Theoretically he was too nice a way, not a Benny Goodman. We all have had experiences with Benny Goodman you know, most of them not greatly pleasurable. But anyway, that’s all, I don’t want to go into that.
